description.value: Sushi Mura is a Japanese sushi restaurant chain founded in Vancouver in 2012, with the Richmond branch situated in the Hollybridge Way commercial area. The restaurant emphasizes daily-delivered fresh fish and authentic Japanese recipes, offering a broad menu spanning rolls, sashimi, nigiri, tempura, and cooked entrees. It is part of a growing multi-location franchise across Metro Vancouver, making it a recognizable and consistent stop for a sit-down or takeout meal.

bike_parking_detail: 8 racks within 100m: rack at 7m; rack at 64m; rack at 66m; rack at 75m; rack at 77m; rack at 84m; rack at 92m; rack at 99m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at sushi-mura.com is active and confirms the Richmond location at #115-5508 Hollybridge Way with phone 604-284-5595, which was absent from the OSM record. Takeout is explicitly confirmed on the front page ('take-out menu is available for pick-up from our restaurant, and delivery via UberEats, Skip The Dish and DoorDash'). The menu lists numerous items tagged 'Veggie' confirming vegetarian options; no evidence was found for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or other cyclist-specific amenities.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; 604-284-5595 was sourced from the website's Richmond location listing and added to the phone field.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active multi-location restaurant with a confirmed website and Richmond address; useful to touring cyclists as a dine-in or takeout meal stop.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists multiple vegetarian items tagged 'Veggie' including Veggie Wakame (seaweed salad), Vegetable Tempura, Vegetable Sunomono, Edamame, and Gomae (spinach with peanut dressing)
